title: Unpaid road-maintenance wages in Nangkor Gewog, Zhemgang
reason: The report describes a wage grievance among about 12 workers but no public protest assembly; workforce size is not attendance.
notes: BBS published the account on 2021-04-11 and says the workers had gone unpaid since February. They had raised the issue with engineers, and the report says local administration reappropriated funds. No public gathering, simultaneous group attendance, or explicit public policy protest demand is reported. February onset of wage nonpayment is not an event start date. This is an exclusion/screening lead, not evidence that no other February protest occurred.
